title: sohum.geoziptag.entitlement/1
description: A GeoZipTag Pro entitlement. The root is the stored record the console reads and changes. $defs/payload is what the server signs for the app, $defs/signed is the signed envelope the app receives, $defs/public_keys is the key set, and $defs/redeem_request, $defs/check_request and $defs/join_request are the app's calls. Carries no name, email, phone, location or advertising id. See docs/GEOZIPTAG_ENTITLEMENT_SHAPE.md.

kind.description: install: a random id the app makes once on the phone; the default for everyone (decided 2026-11-28). account: a SoHum Account (Supabase sub), used only for team plans and memberships. team: the team itself, which holds a team plan (the plan is inherited by its members, never applied to a phone by team code alone).

source.description: coupon: from a redeem code (first build). trial: a free trial from a redeem code (first build). admin: granted by hand in the console (first build). team: inherited from a team plan by a signed-in member. paid: sold outside the app and granted by an admin; kept in the shape, not in the first build. store: bought through Apple or Google in-app billing; later, not in the first build (the owner's order, 2026-11-28).

store.description: Only when source is store. The server verified the purchase with the store. No card, Apple ID or Google account data is kept.

enabled.description: false: disabled by an admin. A disabled entitlement is signed as enabled:false so the app brings the banner back at once.

redeemed_code_id.description: The redeem code this came from, when source is coupon or trial.

note.description: Free text for operators. Must not hold personal data.

created_by.description: Console actor id for an admin grant; absent for a redeem or a store purchase.

team_id.description: The team a plan or an inherited entitlement comes from (source team).

check_after.description: The app asks again after this time (about daily).

grace_until.description: Offline, the app honours the entitlement until this time (issued_at plus 7 days), never past ends_at.

signed.description: What redeem and check return. The signature is over the exact bytes of payload_b64 (decoded), so nothing needs canonical JSON. The app verifies the signature with a bundled public key, then parses the payload, then checks the dates against its clock.

alg.description: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256, as the wireless updates already use. Other values may be added later.

payload_b64.description: base64url (no padding) of the UTF-8 JSON of $defs/payload.

public_keys.description: The verification keys. The app ships with them. A key id the app does not hold is untrusted; a new key reaches the app in an app update, never from the network alone.

public_key_b64.description: Standard base64 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo. A public key; never the private key.

install_id.description: Random, made by the app once. Not a hardware, advertising or account id.

code.description: As typed. The server ignores case, spaces and hyphens.

store_receipt.description: Later (store billing is not in the first build). The store's receipt or purchase token for the server to verify. Never logged.

check_request.description: The daily re-check. For a signed-in team member the app also sends the SoHum bearer token in the Authorization header (not in the body); the server then adds the team's plan to what it signs. Without a token only the install's own entitlement applies.

join_request.description: Body of join_team. Needs the SoHum bearer token. The code is the team's existing code from the shared register.
